title: Dillon & Kristal
summary: A reception that turned an empty space into a room filled with emotion, romance and celebration.
body:
There is something so special about transforming an empty space into a room filled with emotion, romance and celebration. Seeing it all come together for this wedding was pure magic.

Some weddings stay with you long after the day is over. This was one of them. Every detail came together so beautifully to create a celebration that felt intimate, emotional and truly unforgettable.

title: A first dance on the clouds
summary: Not just a first dance, an experience: a floral canopy above and clouds beneath their feet.
body:
From the floral canopy above to the clouds beneath their feet, this stage was designed around one moment.

It is never just about how it looks. It is about how it all comes together, from the first concept to the last detail.

title: Stacy & Ryan
summary: A grand wedding reception: an enchanting celebration of love and elegance.
body: Arched florals, chandeliers and a towering ivory cake set the scene for Stacy and Ryan's grand wedding reception.

title: Kris' 65th birthday
summary: A milestone birthday celebrated in style at the Hyatt Regency.
body: A 65th birthday deserves a ballroom. We designed the room for an evening of live entertainment and dancing.

title: Hyatt Lime
summary: Luxurious decor for the most premium fete of the Carnival season.
body:
Hyatt Lime 2025: the most premium fete for the year. Luxurious decor, the most decadent food and drinks and the top entertainment.

We have been part of the Lime team for years, including LIME 10 in 2020. Always a pleasure.

title: Chantal & William
summary: Starting the new year with a Bridgerton dream made real.
body: Starting the new year right with the most beautiful love story of Chantal and William. Thank you for allowing us to be a part of this amazing moment. We loved making your Bridgerton dreams a reality.

title: Tiffany & Sachin
summary: Once in a while, in the middle of an ordinary life, love gives us a fairytale.
body: Floral arches, a canopy of white blooms and a room dressed entirely in ivory for Tiffany and Sachin's love story.

title: Sime & Christian
summary: The biggest floral overhead we have ever done, with all custom glass tables and furniture.
body:
Love is in full bloom, and we are taking weddings to a whole new level. We had the pleasure of creating this magical event: the biggest floral overhead to ever be done, with all custom glass tables and furniture. This one was definitely one for the books.

Behind the scenes were months of planning, ordering, designing, prepping and executing. We must thank our amazing team. Without them we could not pull this off.

title: A green enchanted fairytale
summary: Sime and Christian's vivaah sanskar and haldi night, every detail crafted to perfection.
body:
A green enchanted fairytale. Christian and Sime's wedding was nothing short of magical, every detail carefully crafted to perfection.

The haldi night was an evening filled with love and colour, and the vivaah sanskar welcomed guests through a living green entrance.

title: Straight out of a fairytale
summary: A Disney-themed wedding with a castle, lanterns and a canopy of flowers.
body: Straight out of a fairytale. This Disney-themed wedding had us swooning: a night to remember, with stunning table pieces and special effects under a floral overhead.

title: Black and pink
summary: Our favourite black and pink tablescape reception, under low lighting.
body: Low lighting on this black and pink flowery wedding looked absolutely magical. Giving our clients their dream reception, one fairytale at a time.

title: A white wedding
summary: Overhead decor to die for, in a room dressed entirely in white.
body: There are some weddings you never forget, and this one is definitely one of our favourites.

title: Red roses and a petal walkway
summary: Red roses, the perfect symbol of eternal love and passion.
body: Red roses are the perfect symbol of eternal love and passion. We built a petal walkway for this couple, beneath a flower overhead we still cannot get over.

title: Jodel & Tish
summary: From a lot of land to this: a haldi night, a modern mandap and a reception built from the ground up.
body:
This is what we call a transformation. From a lot of land to this. Nothing is done by one person alone, it requires a team, and we had the best team for this one. The bride and groom knew what they wanted and we guided them along to create this magical decor.

We live for an extravagant overhead, and this overhead design was the inspiration for the rest of the room. The mandap was the perfect mix of modern and traditional.

title: Micro weddings at home
summary: Backyards and living rooms transformed into wedding venues.
body:
Just because you are having a micro wedding does not mean you have to compromise on style. Our glass table with floral arrangements is just what you need to create that wow factor.

We can take any room of your home and transform it into a venue. Your backyard is the perfect venue.

title: The Red House and Parliament
summary: Decor for the re-opening of the Red House, and for the first sitting of Parliament later that year.
body:
It was an honour to be chosen to do the decor for the re-opening of the Red House, a momentous occasion.

Later in 2020 we were proud to lend our services to the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago for its first sitting.
